audit.description: The changed production files replace matplotlib imports with real Plotly imports and use Plotly graph object APIs in plotting logic. `opytimizer/visualization/convergence.py` now imports `plotly.graph_objects as go` and constructs `go.Figure`/`go.Scatter`, while `opytimizer/visualization/surface.py` imports the same target API and constructs `go.Figure`, `go.Scatter3d`, and `go.Surface`. Static and dynamic evidence show no matplotlib imports from production repo code, target events from production files, and Plotly resolving from site-packages with no local target provider detected.
evidence: opytimizer/visualization/convergence.py diff removes `import matplotlib.pyplot as plt` and adds `import plotly.graph_objects as go`.
opytimizer/visualization/convergence.py diff uses `go.Figure()`, `fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(...))`, Plotly layout/axis updates, and `fig.show()`.
opytimizer/visualization/surface.py diff removes `import matplotlib.pyplot as plt` and adds `import plotly.graph_objects as go`.
opytimizer/visualization/surface.py diff uses `go.Figure()`, `go.Scatter3d(...)`, `go.Surface(...)`, Plotly layout updates, and `fig.show()`.

Dynamic evidence records target_import events for `plotly.graph_objects` from `opytimizer/visualization/convergence.py` line 6 and `opytimizer/visualization/surface.py` line 5, with origin under site-packages/plotly.
reasons: Changed production code meaningfully uses Plotly graph_objects APIs.
Matplotlib imports were removed from the changed visualization modules.
Dynamic evidence reports zero source imports from production repo code.
Target module origin is the installed Plotly package, and target_local_spec_count is 0.
